Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Swiggy Dineout's DineCash toggle - flip "Use DineCash" and the bill recalculates, the savings banner rewrites, the header shifts color, and cash illustrations burst across it.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Swiggy Dineout checkout ("Paying Smoke House Deli"): a colored header holding "Your bill" with the struck ₹5,000 and the big ₹4,500, a green savings banner ("Wooh! you're saving ₹500"), the "You will earn 10% DineCash" row, the "Use DineCash" toggle row (₹200), Additional Offers, Bill Details, and the green "Proceed to Pay" button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: toggle-driven price recalculation with a floating cash burst.
- Flipping the toggle on: the switch slides and greens (200ms), and instantly 5-7 floating cash-note illustrations burst from the toggle row across the header (rise 120px with drift and rotation, fading over 900ms, 40ms stagger).
- The header's background hue slides from maroon to deep green (350ms) while the big total counts down ₹4,500 -> ₹4,300 (400ms rolling-number) with a small scale bump (1 -> 1.08 -> 1, 250ms).
- The savings banner crossfades its copy and amount ("saving ₹700" with the DineCash line, 250ms) and pulses green once.
- The DineCash row's value flips to the applied state (₹200 struck into the discount, 200ms) and the pay button's amount retotals in the same beat (₹4,368 -> new total, 250ms).
- Toggling off reverses everything without the cash burst - prices count back up and the header returns to maroon.

## Calibration
- Every price surface updates in the same 400ms window - header, banner, bill details, button. Nothing lags a beat behind.
- The cash burst is decorative only on toggle-on; it never replays on scroll or revisit.

## Reduced motion
Prices crossfade to new values; header hue changes without the cash burst.

## Don't miss
- The struck original price sits right above the big total in the header - the discount story stays visible.
- The banner is a real mascot-carrying strip (little character + copy), not a plain text row.
